definition: Source-reviewed ticket/native/claim verdict, admission, budget and runtime aggregate authorities. Counts exclude low-level runner assertions, fact/layer construction, schema validation, serialization, human review/Keep policy and delegation-only wrappers. Reachability is a separate metric.
